# Meeting Briefing: Perplexity AI
**Date/Time:** November 20, 2026 @ 10:00 AM (+05:30)  
**Subject:** Strategic Alignment & Product Updates

---

## Recent developments
* **Open-Weight Models Release:** On November 13, 2026, Perplexity released open weights for `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3` under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face [1]. These specialized decision and text-classification models are built on fine-tuned Qwen architectures to evaluate complex text states [1].
* **Teammates Expansion to Mac:** Perplexity expanded its proactive agentic AI feature, "Teammates," to the Mac app for Max subscribers in mid-November 2026, allowing AI agents to handle tasks like QA, research, and customer service [4].
* **Business Growth & Enterprise Adoption:** In early November 2026, reports noted that Perplexity's run-rate surpassed US$750m, fueled by enterprise adoption such as PayPal's integration (74,000 queries a week) and system-level inclusion in Samsung's Galaxy S26 via Galaxy AI [2].
* **Legal Challenge:** A class-action lawsuit was filed against Perplexity AI in a California federal court on November 12, 2026, alleging that the company misled consumers regarding undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features [3].

---

## Talking points
* **Enterprise Scaling:** Discuss how Perplexity's recent enterprise offerings (such as its AI agent "Computer" and system-level integrations) are scaling across major partners like PayPal and Samsung [2].
* **Developer and Open-Source Ecosystem:** Evaluate the strategic goals behind releasing the `pplx-decider-v1.3` open-weight models under the Apache 2.0 license and how they fit into broader automated research workflows [1].
* **Agentic Capabilities:** Explore the rollout of "Teammates" for Max subscribers on iOS and Mac, and discuss the roadmap for multi-agent workplace automation [4].

---

## Open questions
* How is Perplexity addressing consumer feedback and legal exposure regarding usage caps on paid subscription services following the November 2026 class-action lawsuit [3]?
* What are the monetization and adoption milestones for the newly launched "Teammates" feature on macOS [4]?
* How does Perplexity plan to expand the utility of its newly released `pplx-decider-v1.3` open-weights models within enterprise workflows [1]?

---

## Sources
* [1] CASRAI — Perplexity Releases Open-Weight Decider v1.3 and Flash Decision Models: https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026
* [2] AI Magazine — Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate: https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate
* [3] Top Class Actions — Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features: https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features
* [4] 9to5Mac — Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac
